statements.statement: The patient has known atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations
CPT 93229 mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was provided
The service was ordered to correlate intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias
The service was ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate control management
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
